goals: Enforce Forge workflow policy without orchestrator dependency
Keep guidance assets and runtime gates synchronized
constraints: Use policy-driven generation for guidance and gate scripts
Require code-first BDD and documentation updates

tasks.name: Implement policy sync and generated workflow assets
tasks.description: Create canonical workflow policy and generate AGENTS/rules/skills/check scripts from it.
acceptance_criteria: Workflow assets are generated from policy
Drift check fails when generated files are stale

bdd_scenarios: Given policy definitions, when sync runs, then guidance and check assets match policy
property_invariants: Policy hash is deterministic for unchanged policy content

documentation.decision_notes: Policy-driven generation is the single source-of-truth model.

tasks.name: Upgrade plan contracts and add migration tooling
tasks.description: Require tests/documentation task metadata and support migration from v1 plans.
acceptance_criteria: Legacy plans fail validation with migration guidance

bdd_scenarios: Given a v1 plan, when migrate command runs, then output validates against v2 schema
property_invariants: Migration preserves task ordering and dependency graph

documentation.decision_notes: Backward compatibility is provided through explicit migration, not dual-schema validation.

tasks.name: Add CLI workflow checks and document usage
tasks.description: Implement workflow check and plan migrate commands, wire CI/verify, and update repo docs.
acceptance_criteria: workflow check command fails missing tests/docs updates
verify and CI both execute workflow enforcement

bdd_scenarios: Given source changes without tests or docs, when workflow check runs, then it fails

documentation.decision_notes: Workflow checks are mandatory in both local verify and CI gates.
